contradictions.meaning: The age does not agree with the date of birth, the wristband text does not agree with the identity, the spoken answer lacks the name, or a name or number repeats another case
An observation states a NEWS2 total that the verified NEWS2 table does not give for its numbers
A result is flagged normal outside its range, flagged abnormal inside it, a critical potassium or sodium is not flagged critical, or a book result differs from the walkthrough row
The last meal or drink is said to be today at a time later than the case's own now
A decision has no correct option, or every option is correct
A male patient is marked pregnant
The case has a sepsis problem but every white cell count, CRP and lactate in it is normal (the guide's own example)
A chronic-disease medicine is named but nothing in the case gives a reason for it (the guide's own example)
The patient has a penicillin allergy that is not a mild old rash and takes a penicillin-group medicine
contradictions.source: SR-2868 (project rule; the mild old rash is not a conflict, as in the medicine workflow)

contradictions.meaning: A planned case expected to go ahead has a last meal that will not meet the fasting rule at the time of surgery
A P0 case lists a problem that no discovery rule reveals, so the trainee could never find it
A result is of a test that no orderable investigation gives
